name: Holiday dungeon reward boxes hold no stock level-80 gear
contract: The Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest gives the CoA level-60 Tankard O' Terror at 8% instead of the level-80 Tankard and Direbrew's Bloody Shanker, the Loot-Filled Pumpkin no longer gives The Horseman's Horrific Helm or Baleful Blade, and the Heart-Shaped Box no longer gives the level-80 Love is in the Air necks.

steps.label: The keg gives the CoA Tankard O' Terror in about 8% of openings
The keg never gives the level-80 Tankard O' Terror
The keg never gives the level-80 Direbrew's Bloody Shanker
The pumpkin never gives the level-80 Horseman's Horrific Helm
The pumpkin never gives the level-80 Horseman's Baleful Blade
The pumpkin still gives its Tricky Treats
The Heart-Shaped Box never gives the level-80 Winking Eye of Love
The Heart-Shaped Box never gives the level-80 Choker of the Pure Heart
The Heart-Shaped Box still gives its Love Tokens
